Game Overview

At its heart, Fruit Cafe: Match 3 is a match-3 game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Fruit Cafe: Match 3 keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Fruit Cafe: Match 3?

Fruit Cafe: Match 3 is a free match-3 game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Fruit Cafe: Match 3 free to play?

Yes, Fruit Cafe: Match 3 is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
